predicates.label: is
predicates.question: Who is {s}?
predicates.describe: Identity, role, occupation, relationship-role or category of the subject, as a noun phrase from the text (e.g. 'a wealthy gentleman from Derbyshire').

predicates.label: has trait
predicates.question: What is {s} like?
predicates.describe: A character trait, quality or state of the subject, as an adjective phrase from the text.

predicates.label: relative of
predicates.question: Who is {s} related to?
predicates.describe: Family relation. args.relation is the subject's role (father, sister, aunt, cousin, ...).

predicates.label: married to
predicates.question: Who is {s} married to?
predicates.describe: Marriage between two people.

predicates.label: engaged to
predicates.question: Who is {s} engaged to?
predicates.describe: An engagement to marry.

predicates.label: friend of
predicates.question: Who are {s}'s friends?
predicates.describe: Friendship.

predicates.label: loves
predicates.question: Who does {s} love?
predicates.describe: Romantic or deep affection toward someone.

predicates.label: dislikes
predicates.question: Who does {s} dislike?
predicates.describe: Dislike, contempt or hostility toward someone or something.

predicates.label: works for
predicates.question: Who does {s} work for?
predicates.describe: Employment, patronage or service.

predicates.label: member of
predicates.question: What is {s} part of?
predicates.describe: Membership in a group, family, regiment, institution.

predicates.label: lives in
predicates.question: Where does {s} live?
predicates.describe: Residence of the subject.

predicates.label: located in
predicates.question: Where is {s}?
predicates.describe: Location of a place or thing.

predicates.label: owns
predicates.question: What does {s} own?
predicates.describe: Ownership or possession.

predicates.label: visits
predicates.question: Where does {s} go?
predicates.describe: A visit or journey to a person or place.

predicates.label: meets
predicates.question: Who does {s} meet?
predicates.describe: A meeting between people.

predicates.label: does
predicates.question: What does {s} do?
predicates.describe: An action or event the subject carries out; object is the verb phrase in past tense taken from the text (e.g. 'refused Mr. Collins's proposal').

predicates.label: says
predicates.question: What does {s} say?
predicates.describe: Direct speech; object is the exact quoted words from the text.

predicates.label: believes
predicates.question: What does {s} think?
predicates.describe: An opinion or belief the subject holds; object is a clause.

predicates.label: feels
predicates.question: How does {s} feel?
predicates.describe: An emotion the subject feels (optionally toward someone in args.toward).

predicates.label: leads to
predicates.question: What does {s} lead to?
predicates.describe: Causation: the subject brings about the object.

predicates.label: means
predicates.question: What does {s} mean?
predicates.describe: Definition of a term or concept, in the text's words.

predicates.label: part of
predicates.question: What is {s} part of?
predicates.describe: Part-whole relation.

predicates.label: has quantity
predicates.question: How much does {s} have?
predicates.describe: A number, amount, income, size or count attributed to the subject.

predicates.label: takes place in
predicates.question: When does {s} happen?
predicates.describe: When or where an event takes place.

predicates.label: recommends
predicates.question: What does {s} recommend?
predicates.describe: Advice or a recommended practice (non-fiction).

predicates.label: states
predicates.question: What does the book say about {s}?
predicates.describe: One declarative claim the text makes about the subject, as a short self-contained sentence in the text's own words. Use only when no more specific predicate fits.

predicates.label: note
predicates.describe: Reader-authored note (owner-only ACL).

predicates.label: highlight
predicates.describe: Reader-authored highlight (owner-only ACL).
